params.prompt: A tall elegant glass hourglass stands upright centre frame; instead of sand, small gold coins fall steadily and evenly through its narrow waist and pile up in the lower bulb. Slow, calm, continuous flow. Photoreal glass with soft refractions, warm gold coins, soft frontal key light, gentle rim light. Locked-off camera, no camera movement. Background is a perfectly even, ultra-saturated pure chroma key green screen (bright key green), flat studio-lit edge to edge, absolutely no shadows cast on the green, no gradient on the green, and no green spill on the subject. The subject is crisply separated from the background with clean edges. No text overlays, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no borders.
